title: Mr. Monday Night
narrativeText: You won the Extreme Championship and the celebration was exactly thirty seconds long. Now a new challenger waits, claiming the title was a fluke. The crowd doesn't think so. Neither do you.

choices.label: Prove It Again
choices.text: Every night is Monday night for R-V-D.

title: Champion's Spotlight
narrativeText: The production crew wants a photo op with the belt. The interviewer shoves a microphone in your face. The crowd is chanting R-V-D. This is the moment — you can be everything they want, or remind them why you are dangerous.

choices.label: Fire Up the Crowd
choices.text: You point to yourself, then the belt, then every corner of the arena. They explode.

choices.label: Show the Teeth
choices.text: The championship has made you a target. Time to remind everyone why that is a mistake.
